settings.relation: Jacob Cole is a world percussionist, instructor, composer, and jazz fusion drummer. As a graduate of Berklee College of Music he has studied with many of the worlds masters. He now takes that knowledge and his depth of experience as a professional musician to the handpan, his primary love and passion.
settings.quote: I’m honored to play Ayasa and call Ralf my friend, he is an amazing human and equally amazing craftsman. My Ayasa 2015 LongLoy can only be described as a pristine musical gift to my soul. Every Ayasa I have tried are among the best looking and sounding handpans in the world!
settings.relation_more: Jacob’s unique style of playing reflects a diverse range of percussive styles and techniques, yet ultimately it is his love for the groove and improvisation that drives his music.
